book.name: 2 KOLINITA
book.title: ME KOLINITA ꞌIDI LETA ꞌELUWENA PAULO ꞌIꞌETOLADINA

content: Gosegwao, Yaubada ꞌina onaoboboma getedi tada nonodi be ooda be yaluyaluwada tagieꞌesasedi yage baibailidi ꞌediyega, be taꞌesasa ꞌaiꞌaila ma ida ꞌamayaba Yaubada ꞌena.
Gosegwao wada yalema, manuna ꞌima bubuna ꞌemiya maiboꞌana boboꞌana. Nigeya ꞌebweu wate nuwami ꞌada gietoꞌumaliyena, nai ꞌada giekwaniyena, nai ꞌada kaboemi.
ꞌIgu ona gete nigeya sabi ꞌenapaꞌalimi, manuna niꞌatu nuwama waꞌewena, nadigega lowa yaeonemi be ꞌaene ꞌomi maꞌegwao tada miya mwawamwawasa.
Niꞌatu manumi yagwaugwausowala ta yatupumi, ga ꞌigu nuwanuwa niꞌatu ꞌiboboꞌana manumi. Gete tuga ꞌamiya mwau, ta tuwa tuga manumi yagwausowala sinabwana.
Lowa ꞌamai Masidonia, nigeya ꞌebweu wate ꞌebe eyawaiꞌata ꞌalobalobai, ta saꞌi wate miyamwau maiboꞌana, nate losaiya sena yaudi ꞌediya be matauta ꞌatemaya.
Ta Yaubada, tauna tonuwamwau ꞌadi togiegwausowala, ꞌaboꞌama ꞌigiegwausowalema yage ꞌeluwa ꞌediyega, nate Taito ꞌina mai ꞌenega,

ta wate tetelimi ꞌenega, manuna Taito ꞌieonegu, ꞌigwae, “Me Kolinita nidi nuwanuwadi be ꞌutatauya sabi ayausidi. Ta niꞌatu ꞌimu ona manuna sitagwaledi ga ꞌidi toꞌumalina ꞌenega sinuwaꞌebuni ma idi dedoi. Gete yaꞌitena ga yagwausowala sinabwana.”
Lowa ꞌimi leta yaꞌetoladina, ga ꞌigienuwa mwauyemi, ga ꞌaboꞌagu wate manuna yanuwamwau, ta gete tuga geyaꞌabo yanuwanuwa mwau leta nina manuna, manuna ꞌomi ꞌimi nuwamwau tuta gidalina namo ꞌenaya.

ꞌEnega ꞌaboꞌagu yagwausowala, nigeya ꞌimi nuwamwau manuna, ta esi manuna ꞌimi nuwamwau ꞌenega wanuwaꞌebuni ꞌimi toꞌumalinao ꞌediyega. ꞌImi nuwamwau nina walotoonaya ꞌaene Yaubada ꞌenega ꞌimai, ta nigeya ꞌebweu wate ꞌemiya toꞌumalina yaguiguinuwe.

Onaꞌaiꞌaila, nuwamwau Yaubada ꞌenega yage boboꞌana, ta ꞌigienuwa ꞌebunida, be ꞌenega ꞌetoseyana taloba. ꞌEnega geyaꞌabo nuwamwau nina taguiguitoyasei. Ta esi mali nuwamwau baleꞌu ꞌenega maꞌetamo ꞌiloemwawasida.

Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌimi nuwamwau gete ꞌenega Yaubada ꞌilememi, ga waetaetapewa, ta waewaiwai be ꞌimi bubuna ꞌida boboꞌana maiboꞌana, ꞌenega toꞌumalina nina manuna wagamwasowala ta wamatauta, ta nuwanuwami be yawawai ꞌemiya, ta wate waewaiwai ga toꞌumalina nina waeꞌisena. Yage maiboꞌadi ꞌediyega ꞌimi guinuwa boboꞌana waeꞌitaena.

ꞌImi leta lowa yaꞌetoladina nigeya gosemi toguinuwa toꞌumalina namo manuna, ta nigeya tauna ꞌana togietoꞌumali manuna, ta esi ꞌomi maiboꞌami manumi, be ꞌaene Yaubada matanaya ꞌimi etapewa waeꞌitae ꞌigu ona ꞌana ematamatana manuna.
ꞌEnega niꞌatu ꞌagwausowala sinabwana. Wate Taito ꞌina gwausowala ꞌaboꞌama ꞌima gwausowala ꞌiloeposeyanena, manuna Taito nina ꞌimi bubuna boboꞌana ꞌenega ꞌiuyawana.
Lowa Taito ꞌimiyami ta yatuputupumi, ga Taito matanega niꞌatu ꞌiꞌitena, ꞌenega nigeya wate ꞌebe omayamaya ꞌeguya. Ta esi ꞌigu ona maiboꞌana ꞌomi manumi ꞌana ꞌaiꞌaila niꞌatu ꞌiapwesa.
Taito niꞌatu ꞌimi ematamatana maiboꞌana ꞌinuwaꞌiꞌisina, tuta nina tauna ꞌena watagwalemi ma imi ꞌatesaꞌala, ꞌenega nuwana waꞌewa ꞌaiꞌailina.
Ta ꞌaboꞌagu wate yagwaugwausowala ꞌimi bubuna boboꞌana maiboꞌana manuna.
